scripts.test:unit: node scripts/run-parallel.mjs "engine=npm run test -w packages/engine" "protocol=npm run test -w packages/protocol" "client=npm run test -w apps/client" "server=npm run test -w apps/server"
scripts.test:changed: node scripts/run-parallel.mjs "engine=npm run test -w packages/engine -- --changed --passWithNoTests" "protocol=npm run test -w packages/protocol -- --changed --passWithNoTests" "client=npm run test -w apps/client -- --changed --passWithNoTests" "server=npm run test -w apps/server -- --changed --passWithNoTests"
scripts.check: node scripts/run-parallel.mjs "typecheck=npm run typecheck" "lint=npm run lint" "nohtml=npm run lint:nohtml" "i18n=npm run lint:i18n" "wrangler=npm run lint:wrangler" "secrets=npm run lint:secrets" "engine=npm run test -w packages/engine" "protocol=npm run test -w packages/protocol" "client=npm run test -w apps/client" "server=npm run test -w apps/server"
scripts.check:fast: node scripts/run-parallel.mjs "typecheck=npm run typecheck" "lint=npm run lint" && npm run test:changed
scripts.check:serial: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:nohtml && npm run lint:i18n && npm run lint:wrangler && npm run test && npm run lint:secrets
